v: I usually run away from these oppression & brutality movies, but DC’s commercial packaging + that crazy classical BGM combo totally worked for me 😄
Looks Vaaaaav on screen... but that Kantara magic never really hit me this time 😪 Too Much Quality with No Clarity!
Story-wise nothing great... but Sujeeth + Thaman woke up the long-forgotten PK fan in me and gave him a proper feast 😄
Very good movie for sure... but with this setup it could have been something EPIC. For me, a golden franchise opportunity missed 😢
Simple, cute and genuinely feel-good ❤️ Nothing fancy, just a light teenage love story that took me straight back to college days.
I liked COOLIE... till that last 30 mins happened 🫩 Soubin + Anirudh were the real stars for me. Rest needs a BIG forgiving heart 😇
Exactly what I expected from YRF spy universe. Not bad, not great either 😄 NTR tried, Hrithik owned the screen... and yes, make him James Bond already 🙏
Sorry KANNAPA. Sorry ADIPURUSH. I found a new No.1 khalakhandam 🙏😂 HHVM somehow survived every warning sign just to punish us in theatres.
Emotional movie without emotions 🙏😪 Srinu and I went in out of curiosity and came out wondering why neither of us had the sense to say NO 😂
Three hours of torture for a story that needed maybe 30–45 mins 😭😂 Prabhas finally arrives like a saviour, not just for Kannappa... for us too 🙏
Loved the idea, realism and performances 🙏 Dhanush is terrific, Nag fits like a glove... but I can totally understand if the length tests your patience.
Good rustic action drama with a solid friendship/betrayal setup. Not a must-watch for me, but definitely a nice comeback for Manoj, Rohith & Bellamkonda 😊
Finally a proper women-led commercial entertainer without all the gyaan 😍 Tabu + Kareena + Kriti simply take over and have fun. Logic can take a small coffee break 😜
Tillu Square adds almost NOTHING new... and that is exactly why it works 😂 Same Tillu madness, same fun, with an extra Radhika kick 😍
Super interesting concept and surprisingly good visuals... but ayyo that SLOOOOOOOOOOOW narration 😞 The lag almost murdered my curiosity before the twist could save it.
I expected another routine patriotic movie and got a proper big-screen blast 🔥 Hrithik + Deepika + those aerial fights in 3D... full paisa vasool for me 😍
Not a cult classic for me... but definitely VERY GOOD 🔥 Smart mix of mythology + superhero masala, and that BGM does a LOT of heavy lifting 🙏
Not Agnyaathavaasi-level disaster... but definitely not good either 😪 Mahesh gives full energy after ages and somehow drags this routine Guruji family curry to watchable territory 🙏
Prashanth Neel basically asked: what if Prabhas did KGF at 10X volume? 😂 Elevations, violence, shadows, swag... 1000% paisa vasool if even 0.1% of you is a Prabhas fan 🙏
Not Hirani’s best for me, but still a good one. SRK is solid, Vicky is 🔥 and if you’ve ever fought with visas/immigration, this will probably hit much harder 🥲
Probably the first FAMILY movie you should never watch with family 😉 Vanga goes full mad mode here. WOW, WTF, delight, disgust... everything at once. Ranbir is 🔥
BOLD, RAW, RUSTIC... and absolutely not for sensitive viewers 🙏 Payal goes all in, Ajay Bhupathi doesn’t play safe and that BGM + camera work are 🔥
Finally a good Salman movie after ages 🙏 Story is thin and I’m tired of Pakistan spy stories, but Bhai + Katrina + action make it a decent festival watch 😉
Nolan gaadi movies decode cheyatam kaadhu raaa... dammunte SKANDA decode cheyandi 🙏🤣 Ram looks good, dances well... migatha antha Boyaaa universe torture.
Beautiful, bold and mature love story 🙏 Naveen is much more than comedy, Anushka fits perfectly... only the actual stand-up comedy could have been funnier 😄
If Pathaan was starter, JAWAN is full SOUTH INDIAN MASS THALI 😍🤣 Nothing new for us South folks, but watching SRK go full Atlee-mass is a proper fan treat.
No big HIGH, no big disappointment either. Vijay + Samantha are cute together and make KUSHI an easy one-time watch... just wish the core conflict hit harder.
ENTERTAIN + ENLIGHTEN 🙏 OMG 2 handles a taboo subject with humour, religion and solid writing without turning into a lecture. Parents, please watch this one.
22 years later, I went in with grown-up logic and came out waiting for Tara Singh to enter Pakistan 😂 Pure nostalgia + Sunny Deol + hand pump goosebumps 🙏
Bad remake, weak music, cringe comedy... but hey, still better than Aacharyaaa 💪😂 Chiru really needs to get out of this bhajana-batch remake zone.
Half-cooked story maybe... but Rajini swag + those cameos + Anirudh BGM make JAILER a proper theatre treat 🙏 Far better than his recent lot.
Adipurush was badly made. Full stop 😄 I don’t need a giant conspiracy from either side to explain it... sometimes a bad movie is simply a bad movie 😉
Music super. Migatha antha almost disaster 🤦‍♂️ 3D made the CGI a little less painful, but casting, dubbing and emotions were still nowhere close to what Ramayana deserved.
I’m a coward with horror movies 😢 and VIRUPAKSHA still dragged me in 😂 Slow first half, terrific second half, killer BGM... and yes, my sleep was gone for a few days.
Ravi Teja as a psycho baddie sounded exciting... movie మాత్రం got scared and protected the HERO image again 🤦‍♂️ Best idea in the film, mostly wasted.
Watched it twice before I could even write about it 🙏 BALAGAM is simple, rooted and beautiful... and yes, this RGV fan had wet eyes in a few scenes 😢
Nani is terrific in this raw mass avatar and the visuals are 🔥 Story మాత్రం felt half-cooked for me. Good one-time watch, could have been much more.
Proper commercial timepass with Vishwak doing almost everything 😄 Fun first half, nice twists, solid second role... and Leon James BGM gives it a good kick.
Story may feel familiar, but Prakash Raj + Brahmanandam make this a MUST WATCH 🙏 Watching Brahmi make us cry after decades of making us laugh... unforgettable.
Started nice, became average... then those last 30 mins hit ❤️ Rohini + Ashish Vidyarthi completely changed the movie for me. Must watch for that emotion alone.
Typical Luv Ranjan madness 😄 First half takes its sweet time, but interval nunchi full fun... and that crazy climax made the whole thing work for me 🤣
SRK comeback ante ila undali 😍 Swagger, action, Deepika, John, killer BGM... and when physics itself gives up, Salman Bhai Irukuuu!!! 🤣🔥
Poonakalu raaledhu... kaani time-pass ayipoyindi 😄 Routine story and weak climax, but vintage Chiru comedy + dialect + dances gave me enough to enjoy once.
Balayya elevations plenty... fresh content very little 🙏 Hardcore fans may enjoy, but for me this is nowhere near Simha, Legend or Akhanda.
Last time Ravi Teja made me leave before climax was Khatarnak... Dhamaka proudly joined that club 🙏😪 Loud, tiring and made me miss Venky/Dubai Seenu Ravi Teja badly.
I’m usually okay with Rohit Shetty nonsense 😄 Problem here is not the nonsense... it simply isn’t funny enough. One-time watch at best.
Technically mind-blowing, emotionally mixed for me. Water world looks beautiful, but the first Avatar spoiled us too much... that once-in-a-lifetime WOW never came back 😞
MAN!!! Such a simple smartphone-age idea turned into a full laugh riot with a lovely point 😄 If you guard your unlocked phone like national security... MUST WATCH 😂
This one made even the theatre AC feel suspicious 😅 Uncomfortable subject, hard-hitting scenes, Samantha solid and Mani Sharma BGM keeps you uneasy throughout. Sensitive hearts, beware 🙏
Just VAAAAAVVVV!!! 🔥 Simple story, but the folklore + raw visuals + BGM + Rishab turn it into full JAATHAARAAA. Last 20 mins... madness 🙏
Style undi, fights unnayi, BGM kuda super... story మాత్రం below average 😪 Good craft keeps trying, but The Ghost never really pulls you in.
Finally... MEGA BOSS IS BACK!!! 😍 Chiru’s eyes do enough mass work, Satyadev almost steals the show and Salman Bhai takes care of all physics violations 😂
Small indie movie, but the screenplay kept me hooked 👍 Cast has limits, budget shows... still the passion and content easily make it worth a watch.
GOOD idea, weak execution 😞 First half drags, second half finally gives the emotion. Vennela Kishore’s regret track hit me the hardest... aa guilt trip vere level 😢
Apparently I watched a different Brahmāstra from the internet 😂 I liked the content and franchise idea... graphicsే నాకు biggest complaint. Watch it and decide for yourself.
DISASTER!!!! 😭 Puri went Pan-India and somehow forgot the Puri-ness itself. No kickass character, no dialogue fire... Ramya Krishna alone trying to save the damage.
EXCELLENT. BRILLIANT. PERFECT sequel 🔥 Treasure hunt + mythology + logic without forcing one side down your throat. I was ready for Part 3 before credits ended 😄
Excellent idea, only above-average movie for me. First half rushed, second half saves it and Kalyan Ram carries almost everything 🙏 Blockbuster talk was bigger than my experience.
I hate love stories... and still came out calling this a CLASSIC ❤️ Sita Ramam got almost everything right. Wife was right to drag me into the theatre 😄
Standalone ga above-average drug-mafia movie. But as the start of Lokesh universe madness? Much more fun 😄 Kamal + Fahadh + VJS + Anirudh BGM do the heavy lifting.
Vivek Athreya + Nani handle a sensitive topic without turning it into a lecture 🙏 Funny, thoughtful, a little long... music could be better, but still a MUST WATCH for me.
More FUN, less FRUSTRATION than F2 😄 Logic ni bayata parking lo pettesi vellandi. Venky Mama + Varun + Sunil + Vennela Kishore take care of the rest 😂
Strictly average. Good core idea buried under full commercial khichdi 😪 Mahesh is the only real saving grace and once again makes me wonder why nobody gives this actor a proper challenge.
DISASTER!!!! 🙏 Chiru + Charan together and still ZERO impact... that itself is some achievement. Almost every big moment reminded me of another movie that did it much better.
Nani stylish ga full show nadipisthadu... Thaman BGM ఇంకో hero 😄 Slick ga undi, fights bagunnayi, but movie ayyaka “inka edo miss ayyindi” feeling మాత్రం పోదు.
Man... simple story ni ila kuda cheppacha 🙏 Satyadev + Venkatesh Maha + Araku world totally worked for me. Slow ga untundi, but beautiful ga lands. MUST WATCH.
Story gurinchi thesis rayalsina avasaram ledu 😄 Kunal + Vijay Raaz + Gajraj Rao gang simply make it a fun weekend timepass. Expect laughs, nothing more.
Dark murder mystery, but without cheap shock tricks 👍 Nawaz + Radhika super, lighting gave me old RGV vibes... konchem slow, but the final twist makes up for it.
Human Computer story kosam vellithe konchem disappoint avvachu. But genius Shakuntala Devi vs normal family life angle worked well for me... Vidya + Sanya are terrific 🙏
Patience compulsory 😄 Lucknow slang + sloooow pace first test chestayi... adjust ayyaka Amitabh vs Ayushmann landlord-tenant Tom & Jerry full fun.
Simple story, zero drama-baazi, beautiful emotion 🙏 Sanjay Mishra makes you feel for all those familiar faces we’ve watched for years but never remembered by name. MUST WATCH.
Basically a regular family love story... only the couple happens to be two men 😄 Neither hard-hitting nor laugh-riot, but it makes the relationship feel refreshingly normal.
Nithiin back on HIT track 😄 Organic farming message pakkana petti Venky Kudumula full comedy mode lo velthadu. Second half nunchi proper commercial timepass.
EXCELLENT!!!!! 🙏 Simple, realistic and no unnecessary melodrama. Kangana super, supporting cast perfect... theatre aina OTT aina, just watch it.
Sci-fi idea bagundi, retro setup interesting... but Ravi Teja energy motham concept ni swallow chesindi 😄 Thaman + Sunil save enough to make it just above average.
Story first 10 mins lone ardham aipothundi... still I liked it to the core 😄 Bunny + Murali Sharma + Trivikram comedy/emotions + Thaman make this simple family story work big time.
Babu neee Maaassu... Mind Blocku 😄 Mahesh mass comeback fans ki feast. Naaku మాత్రం train comedy + weak climax వల్ల average timepass gaane undipoyindi.
Entertainment kosam vellakandi... but definitely WATCH IT 🙏 Meghna keeps the pain and message simple without forcing tears, and Deepika + Vikrant do the rest.
Rajini style + Anirudh BGM... akkada varaku super 🔥 Migatha story/logic chusthe Murugadoss really wrote this aa? ane doubt vachindi 😦
Shatamanam Bhavati déjà vu strong ga undi 😄 But Rao Ramesh alone becomes hero + villain + comedian and somehow keeps this routine family drama alive.
Casting + makeup మాత్రం terrific... movie మాత్రం political spoof collection la anipinchindi 😐 RGV says audience wants entertainment. Naaku ikkada adhe miss ayyindi.
Title laga this is Venky Mama’s show 😄 His comedy + emotion + mama-alludu chemistry save whatever they can... climax varaku మాత్రం patience test full ga.
LOVED IT!!!!!! 😂 Logic, emotion, message anni intlo vadilesi vellandi. Akshay full madness... only my Aakhri Pasta deserved much better 😄
First 45 mins almost punishment 😪 But revolt start ayyaka movie totally changes gear. Chiru’s eyes + dialogue diction + final stretch make it a proper big-screen ride 🙏
Personally, I LOVED it 😄 Simple revenge story, but Vikram Kumar gives it his own flavour. Nani natural ga rocks... expectations ni konchem pakkana petti chudandi.
Man!!!! What a movie 🙏 College friendship, comedy, emotion, message... anni correct mix lo land ayyayi. Dil Chahta Hai / 3 Idiots zone lo happily pettestha.
Ayushmann ki ee subjects select chese dhairyam ekkadi nunchi vasthundo 😄 Naughty setup ni vulgar ga kakunda full fun ga handle chesaru. Supporting gang కూడా rocks.
Puri + Mani + Ram kalisi proper garam masala biryani vandaaru 🔥 Logic pakkana, MASS full ga. Ram energy ento devudike teliyali 😂 Poyiiii kummundri!!!!!
Brahmotsavam tarvatha na patience ni ila test chesina movie idhe 🙏😪 20-min story ni 150 mins ‘realism’ peru tho stretch chesi champesaru.
REEListic story with REAListic emotions 🙏 Nani ki ee role cakewalk laga untundi. Mass kosam kaadu... emotion connect ayithe Jersey definitely hits hard.
FUN kosam vellanu... FRUSTRATION ekkuva vachindi 😪 Story, comedy, songs, overacting anni test chesayi. Vintage Venky comedy okkate naaku real fun.
Ram Charan did a Balakrishna 😂 Boyapati regular excess ni kuda OVER-dose chesadu. Physics, biology, geography anni holiday lo... Charan మాత్రం madness ni confidently survives.
Go get RAJINIfied!!! 😍 Story/logic pakkana petti Rajini style + Anirudh BGM kosam vellandi. Karthik Subbaraj finally gives Thalaivaa the commercial feast fans wanted.
DISAPPOINTED 😞 Balayya effort 1000%, but 3 hours of movie recreations without enough drama exhausted me. Ee life story ki web series space better undedi.
Shankar imagination ki hats off 🙏 Out-of-box sci-fi idea + huge visual ambition + Rahman BGM... ee scale lo dream chese filmmakers ni support cheyyali.
Basic story, basic execution... but Nani handles acting, Nag handles glamour 😄 Their combo + good BGM make it a decent timepass.
What a movie!!!!! 🙏 Familiar love-story space ni so natural ga, sensitive ga chepparu. Characters, dialogues, little songs... everything feels lived, not acted. Repeat-watch list.
Ranbir makeup lo 80% Sanju ayithe, acting lo 200% Sanju 🙏 Vicky కూడా superb. Hirani’s version of the story worked well for me as a father-son + friendship drama.
GOOD news: Pa. Ranjith didn’t change after Kabali. BAD news: exactly the same 😂 Rajini kosam vellina naaku mostly patience testే. Kabali itself felt better.
I know I’m in the minority 😄 Officer worked for me. Realistic action, strong BGM, RGV angles and a vulnerable Nag... regular hero elevations expect cheyakunda chudandi.
Haa... ee movie gurinchi ఎంత రాసినా emotion complete ga cheppalenu 🙏 Mahanati pulled me into that era and Keerthy + Dulquer simply LIVED those roles. EPIC.
Father wants to send his 75-year-old son to an old-age home 😂 Premise itself enough! Amitabh + Rishi give laughs, emotion and a lovely message without turning it into a tear-fest.
Leader ni full commercial BLOCKBUSTER package lo cook chesthe Bharath Ane Nenu 😄 Freshness meeda doubts unna, Mahesh + dialogues + DSP + elevations totally work.
3 hours ante patience kavali 😄 But Charan, Samantha, Aadhi, Jagapathi Babu + that beautiful 80s Godavari world made Rangasthalam worth it for me. Charan finally shows the ACTOR 🙏
VERY GOOD ki GREAT ki madhyalo ekkado 🙏 Raw ga, honest ga untundi. Class topper kaani vallaki ee marks/job/settle pressure chaala familiar ga hit avvachu.
Hmmm... totally disconnected 😄 Visuals bagunnayi, Varun + Raashii mature ga act chesaru... but ee love-at-first-sight + ego-love story naaku malli work avvaledu.
AWEsomely awful aa... AW(E)fully awesome aa? 😄 Decide cheskondi. Naaku మాత్రం every few mins something interesting undi, Regina + BGM especially stood out.
Intha controversy, intha grandeur... naaku మాత్రం story very thin ga anipinchindi 😐 Ranveer super, climax/jauhar portions Bhansali magic... migatha chala flat.
Sharmaaaa... Varmaaaaa... manakenti ee KHARMA!!! 😭 Story familiar aina screenplay/directing save cheyyali ga... ikkada PK quirks ni కూడా overkill chesesaru.
BHAI can carry routine movies with presence... but Tubelight needed Salman to disappear into the character. Naaku మాత్రం BHAI ni marchipoyi Laxman ni nammadam jaragaledu 😄
Old Sarkar magic malli raledu... but Govinda BGM, Nagre aura, weird RGV angles and a few solid lines make this a decent return. Home ki raaledu, road మాత్రం dorikindi 😄
Rajamouli elevations + emotions + Keeravani BGM = full blast 🔥 Rana and Anushka are the real pillars here. Logic pakkana petti experience ni enjoy cheyyandi.
Chunky Panday scary ga kanipisthe movie something special ani ardham 😂 Bold, raw, terrific performances... and Vidya is absolutely the BEGUM JAAN 🙏
One ticket konna... THREE movies free ga vachayi 😭😂 Srinu Vaitla multithreading screenplay + three climaxes... 2h40m somehow felt like 10 hours.
Expectations ni basement lo petti vellandi 😄 Story marchipondi, songs appudu eyes + ears close cheyyandi... PK okkade ee cheap-looking package ni somehow carry chesthadu.
Dowry + women independence meeda good point... commercial treatment motham confuse chesindi 😐 Neither strong message movie nor proper entertainer. And title Vaidehi Ka Dulha kada? 😄
Attitude is Everything kaadu... NANI is everything 😄 Logic theatre bayata switch off chesi vellandi. Story nonsense aina Nani alone makes it proper paisa vasool.
Glad I did NOT miss this one 🙏 Railway Raju vs Imtiaz vs TIME itself... tight screenplay, terrific BGM and hardly one useless scene. Ee cinema deserves more love.
Old family storyే... but clean ga, warm ga, mana intlo vallala characters tho chepthe fresh ga feel avvachu ani prove chesindi 😄 LOVED IT TO THE CORE.
Did I go for a fresh story? NO 😂 BOSS comeback kosam vella... comedy, emotion, dance, screen fire అన్నీ intact. BOX-OFFICE AMMA MOGUDU IS BACK!!!!!
Telugu pride hype pakkana petti normal historical movie ga chusthe GOOD one 👍 Krish sharp ga handles it, dialogues roar... and honestly Satakarni ga Balayya ne set avthadu.
FILM ga loved it 🙏 Real-life story ga మాత్రం father ni hero chesi daughters’ sacrifice ni pakkana pettadam naaku digest avvaledu. Great cinema, complicated feeling.
RGV movie lo camera, lights, BGM, acting usually untayi... STORYే missing avvachu 😄 This time story కూడా undi. Situations ni villain ga cheyyadam lo master still master.
What a movie 🙏 SRK super mature ga untadu... but after some time screen meeda Alia kanapadadu, only KAIRA. Their combo is such a lovely treat.
First hour ‘What the F***’... next hour ‘WHAT A F***’ 😂 Romance almost lost me, but shift ayyaka full BANG. Chaitanya best performance till then for me.
Pure romance usually naaku nidra teppisthundi 😄 Premam మాత్రం comedy + emotion balance tho keep chesindi. Naa Autograph minus heavy sentiment, plus easy fun.
Pure PURI markISM 😄 Dialogue bombs straight MISSILES, second half racy, Kalyan Ram uber-cool. Puri fans ki feast... story మాత్రం vere writer daggara nunchi teesukunte ఇంకా బాగుంటుంది 😂
Different, mature concept with very quiet emotions. Regular audience ki 2 hoursే 4 hours laga anipinchachu 😄 Different cinema ishtam unte one-time watch worth it.
Simple story, simple screenplay, simple everything 😄 No WOW... thankfully no VAMMOO either. Final 10 mins + Nani make it comfortably timepass.
TERRIFIC movie. TERRIFIC performances. HUGE impact 🙏 Taapsee completely owned it for me... and everything finally comes down to one simple line: NO means NO.
Sensible, clean, witty, emotional... chaala nachindi 🙏 Simple story ni Avasarala writing + Rohit/Shaurya/Regina performances another level ki teesukellayi. Second half ఇంకా better.
Basically Koratala’s Sarkar 😄 Story/execution new ga anipinchaledu... but Mohanlal + NTR POWER PACKED, and DSP BGM theatre nunchi vachaka కూడా head lo tirigindi.
Hype motham forget chesi chusthe Kabali is actually a slow family drama inside a mafia setup. Rajini gets room to ACT, and Radhika Apte sometimes even dominates him 🙏
Simply SUPERB!!!!! Nani acting FULL MEALS 🙏 Different concept, superb BGM, zero boring moments. Hero aa villain aa pakkana petti... NANI oka GOPPA ACTOR.
Movie chusaka fans enduku ‘first watch then talk’ annaro ardham ayyindi 😂 Narakam close-up lo chusaka clarity vachindi. Bala Tripuramani song తప్ప almost everything exhausted me.
SHELL SHOCKED!!!!! 🔥 Intha complex time-travel story ni banana peel chesinattu simple ga explain cheyyadam ela? Vikram Kumar + Suriya, take a BOW 🙏
GREAT ki just short... VERY NICE మాత్రం pakka 😄 Nag nails it, Karthi is super lovable, emotion + entertainment balance works. Still, somewhere aa small ‘something missing’ feeling undi.
